asf_method: Fixed-reference ASF recomputation: per target, all `pool_objectives` points of every successful run (all conditions) are pooled; each objective dimension (egarps/rhofold/iptm_component; all maximized) is min-max normalized with bounds from that pool. The shared reference point is the per-dimension best over the target's Serial (bmc_max_rounds=0) pools ('utopian-of-Serial'), normalized with the same bounds. ASF distances of every run's best candidate are recomputed against this fixed reference with uniform weights and rho=1e-3 via agent_core.workflows.multi_objective.achievement_scalarizing_function. The stored asf_distance uses a per-run utopian reference and is NOT comparable across conditions (see multi_objective.py ANALYSIS CAVEAT), so it is never used for cross-condition tests. Targets whose runs all lack pool_objectives fall back to best-candidate vectors for bounds.
hv_method: Exact hypervolume by recursive slicing along the first dimension (no third-party library). Per (target, seed_idx) cell the candidate pools (`pool_objectives`) of Serial and BMC x1/x2/x3 are compared; the reference point is the componentwise minimum of the merged pool across all conditions in that cell minus a 1e-6 margin. All objectives are maximized. Computed for the full 3-D objective vector and for three 2-D projections (egarps-rhofold, egarps-iptm, rhofold-iptm).
paired_tests_note: ASF/component tests pair per target (mean over successful seed sets); hypervolume tests pair per (target, seed_idx) cell. BH-FDR computed over one family of up to 24 tests (4 metrics + 4 hypervolumes, x 3 comparisons each; entries with n=0 carry no p-value).
